# Transient Alarms on S-SUD-003 With No Service Impact

- **Classification:** no_impact
- **Root cause:** no_impact at `S-SUD-003`
- **Confidence:** low (Alarms cleared quickly, KPIs showed 100 percent availability, and changes, maintenance, and external events were ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-13 03:18 to 2026-09-13 04:16
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-13 03:18
- **Affected:** S-SUD-003

## Summary

Site S-SUD-003 experienced brief transient environmental or power fluctuations causing self-clearing minor and warning alarms without service degradation.

No service impact: 29 minor and warning alarms raised and cleared within minutes, while KPIs remained completely normal.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-13 03:18: Site S-SUD-003 raised warning TEMP_HIGH and minor RECTIFIER_FAULT alarms. [ALM-000238, ALM-000239, T3]
- 2026-09-13 03:30: Site S-SUD-003 raised minor FAN_FAILURE alarms. [ALM-000242, T3]
- 2026-09-13 03:32: Site S-SUD-003 raised minor VSWR_HIGH alarms. [ALM-000243, T3]
- 2026-09-13 03:33: Site S-SUD-003 raised warning DOOR_OPEN alarms. [ALM-000245, T3]
- 2026-09-13 04:16: All 29 alarms cleared on S-SUD-003. [T3]

## Evidence

- Site S-SUD-003 raised 29 minor and warning alarms between 2026-09-13 03:18 and 2026-09-13 04:16. [T3]
- All 29 alarms self-cleared within ten minutes of being raised. [T3]
- Cells C-SUD-003-1, C-SUD-003-2, and C-SUD-003-3 maintained 100 percent availability with normal traffic and drop rates. [T5]
- No changes occurred on S-SUD-003 or its parents between 2026-09-12 18:00 and 2026-09-13 08:32. [T6]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-SUD-003 or its parents between 2026-09-12 18:00 and 2026-09-13 08:32. [T7]
- No external events were recorded for region SUD between 2026-09-12 18:00 and 2026-09-13 06:00. [T9]

## Hypotheses

1. **no_impact** at S-SUD-003: confirmed. Alarms were transient and self-clearing, KPIs remained healthy, and no changes or external events occurred. [T3, T5, T6, T9]
2. **power_failure** at S-SUD-003: rejected. Rectifier alarms were transient and self-clearing, and availability remained at 100 percent without an outage. [ALM-000239, T3, T5]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000238: Warning temperature alarms self-cleared quickly and caused no service degradation.
- ALM-000239: Minor rectifier fault alarms self-cleared within minutes without impacting site power or availability.
- ALM-000242: Minor fan failure alarms self-cleared without causing sustained overheating or service impact.
- ALM-000243: Minor VSWR high alarms self-cleared quickly without degrading radio link performance.
- ALM-000245: Warning door open alarms self-cleared and had no impact on site service KPIs.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor site S-SUD-003 environmental and power sensors for recurring transient alarms.
- Inspect physical cabinet filters and cooling fans during the next routine maintenance window.
